description: At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace. People-driven culture At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing. With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace. Position Overview: Boeing Digital Services org is currently looking for Lead Product Owner to join their team in Bengaluru, KA. As a Product Owner, you will be part of the Boeing Global Services, which develops software applications and products for that create direct value to its customers. We provide re-vamped work environments focused on delivering data-driven solutions at a rapidly increased pace over traditional development. Be a part of our passionate and motivated team who are excited to use the latest in software technologies for modern web and mobile application development. Through our products we deliver innovative solutions to our global customer base at an accelerated pace. Position Responsibilities: (Desired Skills/Experience): Define, own, and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for aviation / MRO software products, ensuring alignment with customer needs and business objectives. Own, create, and continuously prioritize the product backlog, ensuring it reflects business value, customer priorities, technical dependencies, and risk. Write clear and concise epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, ensuring requirements achieve the right level of Definition of Ready (DOR). Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, customers, and the development team, representing the voice of the customer throughout delivery. Leverage MRO domain expertise to clarify requirements, resolve functional questions, and make informed day-to-day product decisions and trade-offs. Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and demos; accept or reject completed work based on the agreed acceptance criteria. Work with the development team to confirm that the delivered software and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Define, measure, and report on product success metrics and KPIs, and use insights to drive continuous improvement. Manage stakeholder expectations, communicate release plans and progress, and ensure change requests are assessed for impact and appropriately prioritized. Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and impediments, escalating and driving them to resolution in a timely manner. Contribute to Program Increment (PI) planning, commit to Team PI Objectives, and ensure iteration plans deliver incremental customer value. Ensure compliance with relevant aviation regulatory and airworthiness requirements is reflected in the product requirements where applicable. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification. 11+years relevant experience, with a significant portion in a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst role. Strong working knowledge of the Aviation / Aerospace domain is a minimum requirement, with hands-on understanding of Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) operations, processes, and terminology. Familiarity with MRO business processes such as line and base maintenance, component repair, inventory and parts management, airworthiness and regulatory compliance (FAA/EASA/DGCA), work orders, and turnaround time (TAT) optimization. Proven experience owning and managing a product backlog - writing clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and prioritizing based on business value, risk, and dependencies. Hands-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments; knowledge and/or experience of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and the Product Owner/Product Manager role within it. Ability to translate business and customer needs into a clear product vision, roadmap, and well-defined, prioritized requirements. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage customers, business sponsors, engineering teams, and leadership, and to balance competing priorities. Experience defining and tracking product success metrics and KPIs, and using data to drive prioritization and decision-making. Excellent communication, facilitation, and documentation skills, including the ability to clearly articulate requirements to both technical and non-technical audiences. Proficiency with product and Agile management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent. Experience with cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure and an appreciation of modern software delivery practices (CI/CD, APIs, integrations) is desirable. Working understanding of the Java programming language and the Java/Spring technology stack - sufficient to reason about system behavior, review technical designs, and write clear, measurable performance and non-functional requirements (even though hands-on coding is not expected). Knowledgeable in AI tools and able to leverage them (e.g. generative AI assistants for requirement drafting, backlog refinement, user-story generation, documentation, and data analysis) to improve product-management productivity and decision-making. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): Experience with DevOps Practices such as Continuous integration and continuous deployment (using Microsoft DevOps), configuration management, metrics and monitoring schemes, virtualization and cloud computing using Microsoft Azure Proficiency in Angular or React Native for cross-platform mobile development Solid understanding of mobile UI/UX best practices and platform-specific design guidelines Knowledge and/or experience of the Aviation Industry desirable Familiarity with Java software development in order to effectively perform analysis of issues and identify potential code defects Scripting experience with JavaScript, Python. Typical Education & Experience : Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 12+ years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g. Master 11+ years') related in computer science, aerospace or other closely related field. Relocation: This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility. Applications for this position will be accepted until Nov. 29, 2026 Export Control Requirements: This is not an Export Control position. Education Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required Relocation This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility. Visa Sponsorship Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status. Shift Shift 1 - Morning (India) Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law. We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world’s most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews. Your Benefits No matter where you are in life, our benefits help prepare you for the present and the future. Competitive base pay and incentive programs. Industry-leading tuition assistance program pays your institution directly. Resources and opportunities to grow your career. Up to $10,000 match when you support your favorite nonprofit organizations.
